NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Settings.UploadLocati: Folder where pasted and dropped images are stored. A single folder name is created inside the world folder; use s3://bucket/folder for an S3 bucket.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Settings.UploadSubfol: Store uploaded images in subfolders of the upload location.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Settings.GmUploadRela: Upload via GM for Players Without Upload Permission
Lets users who may share images but lack the "Upload New Files" permission share pasted images anyway: a connected GM's client uploads them (images only, up to 50 MB). Requires a GM to be online.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Settings.CompressImag: Convert pasted and dropped images to WebP before uploading (when it makes them smaller). Disable to upload originals, e.g. for detailed maps. Animated images are never converted.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Settings.MinRole.Name: Minimum Required Role
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Settings.MinRole.Hint: The lowest user role that can use the image menu, paste and drop images, and have image links embedded in chat.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Settings.MaxImageDime: When compressing, shrink images whose longest side is larger than this many pixels. Set to 0 to keep the original size.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Settings.EnableDragDr: Allow dropping image files, or images dragged from web pages, onto the chat to share them.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Settings.PasteMode.Hi: Where pressing Ctrl+V (Cmd+V) with an image on the clipboard shares it. "Anywhere outside text fields" also catches pastes on the canvas, which other modules may use, e.g. to create tiles.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Settings.ContextMenuM: When right-clicking an image should open the Show & Tell menu.
Everywhere except character and item sheets
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Settings.ChatImageMax: Maximum height (in pixels) of images in chat. Click an image to view it full size. Set to 0 for no limit.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Settings.DebugLogging: Log details about pasting, compressing and uploading images to the browser console. Useful for troubleshooting.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.ShareDialog.Title: Share Image
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.ShareDialog.Caption: Caption
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.ShareDialog.NoOtherUs: There are no other users in this world.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Notifications.DropHin: Drop the image to share it
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Notifications.LocalFi: A file path on your computer can't be shared. Drag the file into the chat instead.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Notifications.PasteFa: The pasted or dropped image could not be read.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Notifications.NoWhisp: Select at least one recipient to whisper the image to.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Notifications.LinkCop: Link copied to the clipboard (copying the image itself requires HTTPS).
Link copied to the clipboard (this browser can't copy images).
The image itself couldn't be copied, so its link was copied instead.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Notifications.Animate: Animated images lose their animation when copied, so the link was copied instead.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Notifications.Downloa: The image could not be downloaded.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Notifications.UploadF: The image could not be uploaded. Check the console for details.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Notifications.ShareFa: The image could not be posted to chat. Check the console for details.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Notifications.NoUploa: You do not have permission to upload images. Ask your GM to enable "Upload New Files" for your role in User Management, or to enable uploading via GM in the module settings.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Notifications.RemoteI: The image could not be downloaded — the website blocked the request. Save the image to your computer first, then drag it into the chat.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Notifications.EmptyIm: The image is empty and cannot be uploaded.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Notifications.UploadN: Upload failed — the server did not return a file path.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Notifications.RelayTo: The image is too large to upload via the GM (maximum 50 MB).
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Notifications.RelayTi: The GM's client did not respond to the upload request. Make sure a GM is connected and try again.
NIKS-SHOW-AND-TELL.Notifications.RelayRe: The GM's client rejected the upload. Only images can be uploaded via the GM.
